title: Catalogue price range
statementMd:
Show the cheapest price, the most expensive price and the average price (rounded to 2 decimals) across all products.

Expected columns: `cheapest`, `priciest`, `avg_price`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT MIN(price) AS cheapest, MAX(price) AS priciest, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
